set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3997b2a0bc2bbdb30a4aa0fbf62648c32b6bb52d

ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3997b2a0bc2bbdb30a4aa0fbf62648c32b6bb52d
PREV=a47d2e8c42f084965ac4bc63ea98d18e7ca68409
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PREV"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
mkdir -p .dev
cp .dev/app.db .dev/app.db.pre-rejected-retention-0021-3997b2a.sqlite
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
conn=sqlite3.connect('.dev/app.db')
assert conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0] == 'ok'
print('sqlite_integrity_before=ok')
for table in ('photo','memory'):
    rejected=conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table} WHERE status='rejected'").fetchone()[0]
    retained=conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table} WHERE status='rejected' AND original_path IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]
    print(f'before_{table}_rejected={rejected} original_path_nonnull={retained}')
PY
sudo -n systemctl stop photomap.service
restart_service() { sudo -n systemctl start photomap.service || true; }
trap restart_service EXIT
git merge --ff-only "$EXPECTED"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
( cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head )
make schema-check
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
conn=sqlite3.connect('.dev/app.db')
version=conn.execute('SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version').fetchone()[0]
assert version == '0021_nullable_rejected_original_path', version
for table in ('photo','memory'):
    cols={row[1]: row for row in conn.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({table})')}
    assert cols['original_path'][3] == 0, (table, cols['original_path'])
print('schema_0021_nullable_original_path=ok')
PY
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/retain_private_originals.py --dry-run --approved-days 1000000 --rejected-days 0 --output-json .dev/retain-rejected-dryrun-3997b2a.json
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.dev/retain-rejected-dryrun-3997b2a.json').read_text())
a=r['summary']['actions']; i=r['summary']['issues']['by_severity']
assert i == {'error': 0, 'warning': 0, 'info': 0}, i
assert a['approved_replaced'] == 0, a
assert a['already_retained'] == 0, a
conn=sqlite3.connect('.dev/app.db')
expected=sum(conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table} WHERE status='rejected' AND original_path IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0] for table in ('photo','memory'))
assert a['rejected_removed'] == expected, (a, expected)
print('dryrun_rejected_removed=' + str(a['rejected_removed']))
print('dryrun_approved_replaced=0')
PY
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/retain_private_originals.py --apply --approved-days 1000000 --rejected-days 0 --output-json .dev/retain-rejected-apply-3997b2a.json
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.dev/retain-rejected-apply-3997b2a.json').read_text())
a=r['summary']['actions']; i=r['summary']['issues']['by_severity']
assert i == {'error': 0, 'warning': 0, 'info': 0}, i
assert a['approved_replaced'] == 0, a
conn=sqlite3.connect('.dev/app.db')
remaining=sum(conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table} WHERE status='rejected' AND original_path IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0] for table in ('photo','memory'))
assert remaining == 0, remaining
print('apply_rejected_removed=' + str(a['rejected_removed']))
print('rejected_original_path_nonnull_after=0')
PY
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/retain_private_originals.py --dry-run --approved-days 1000000 --rejected-days 0 --output-json .dev/retain-rejected-postdryrun-3997b2a.json
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.dev/retain-rejected-postdryrun-3997b2a.json').read_text())
a=r['summary']['actions']; i=r['summary']['issues']['by_severity']
assert i == {'error': 0, 'warning': 0, 'info': 0}, i
assert a['approved_replaced'] == 0 and a['rejected_removed'] == 0, a
print('postdryrun_actions=0')
PY
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/diagnose_local_data.py --output-json .dev/diagnose-after-rejected-retention-3997b2a.json
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.dev/diagnose-after-rejected-retention-3997b2a.json').read_text())
i=r['summary']['issues']['by_severity']; s=r['summary']['storage']
assert i['error'] == 0, i
assert s['orphan_private_files'] == 0, s
assert s['orphan_public_files'] == 0, s
conn=sqlite3.connect('.dev/app.db')
assert conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0] == 'ok'
print('diagnostics_status=' + r['status'])
print('diagnostics_issues=' + repr(i))
print('orphan_private_files=0 orphan_public_files=0')
print('sqlite_integrity_after=ok')
PY
du -sb backend/storage | awk '{print "storage_bytes_after="$1}'
sudo -n systemctl start photomap.service
trap - EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health > /tmp/photomap-health.json; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
cat /tmp/photomap-health.json
test "$(sudo -n systemctl is-active photomap.service)" = active
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
printf 'root_http='
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/
echo service_status=active
echo production_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo rejected_retention_fix_ok
REMOTE
